name: Tribulus terrestris
description: Puncture vine, a plant used in herbal medicine; contains steroidal saponins, mainly protodioscin

status.usStatus: Dietary supplement · not an approved drug

note.text: Case reports describe kidney and liver injury and breast growth in men who used tribulus.

bullets: Effects are attributed to **steroidal saponins**, mainly protodioscin
**In trials,** testosterone, androstenedione and LH mostly did not change
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Meta-analysis: no change in total testosterone

practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement; not FDA reviewed before sale
practical.monitored: Erectile function scores, testosterone, PSA, liver enzymes

regulatory.text: No approved drug; sold as dietary supplement

references: Int J Impot Res, tribulus for erectile dysfunction meta-analysis, Jan 2026
Maturitas, tribulus in male sexual dysfunction, May 2017
J Strength Cond Res, tribulus in elite rugby league players, May 2007
